title: Tufafi da kwalliya
description: Ten stories and columns about clothes and looking good: a bride's plaits, wrappers and bracelets, a young man's narrow trousers at the tailor's, a white dress splashed with filth in the rain, a night break-in at a cloth market, an online seller's trip to buy abayas in Kuwait, the clothes of worship in mosque and church, a column on a ban on tight clothes, a cowboy-costume picnic in Jos, a young designer with sickle cell facing surgery, and a school visit to the ruins of an old palace and its clothes.

lessons.title: Kayan amarya
lessons.summary: A week before her wedding, Rahamatu's friend Abida brings good news from the tailor, plaits her hair, helps her try on wax-print cloths, a white wrapper at the waist, gold bracelets and rose oil; the women clap at the wedding and the couple go on honeymoon in Jos.
lessons.text:
Rahamatu za ta yi aure a ranar Asabar mai zuwa, kuma tun makon da ya wuce gidansu ya cika da 'yan uwa da ƙawaye. A ranar Laraba da safe, ƙawarta Abida ta shigo da gudu tana dariya.

"Rahamatu, ina yi miki albishir! Tela ya gama ɗinka kayanki duka, kuma sun yi kyau fiye da yadda muka zata."

Rahamatu ta yi murmushi, ta ce, "Allah ya saka miki da alheri. Wannan ne albishir mafi daɗi da na ji a wannan mako."

Abu na farko da suka yi shi ne kitso. Abida ƙwararriya ce a harkar kitso; tun tana ƙarama take yi wa ƙawayenta kitso a ƙofar gida. Ta zaunar da Rahamatu a kan wata ƙaramar kujera, ta wanke mata gashi, ta shafa masa mai, sannan ta fara kitso irin na amare. Kitson ya ɗauki awa huɗu, amma da ta gama, duk wanda ya shigo ɗakin ya ce bai taɓa ganin kitso mai kyau irinsa ba.

Sannan suka buɗe akwatin kaya. A ciki akwai atamfa guda shida masu launi daban daban: ja, kore, shuɗi da launin ruwan ɗorawa. Mahaifiyar Rahamatu ce ta saya mata atamfar a kasuwa, domin al'ada ce a ƙasar Hausa a ba amarya atamfa da yawa. Abida ta ɗauki wata atamfa mai launin kore, ta ce, "Wannan atamfa za ki sa a ranar walima."

Akwai kuma wani farin zani mai ado na zare mai sheƙi. Rahamatu ta tashi, ta ɗaura zanin a ƙugunta, ta juya a gaban madubi. Zanin ya ɗan yi mata yawa a ƙugu, sai Abida ta sake ɗaure shi da ƙarfi. "Ƙugunki ya rage tun watan da ya wuce! Kada ki ƙara rage nauyi kafin Asabar, ko zanin nan ya faɗi a gaban jama'a." Su biyun suka yi dariya.

Daga nan suka duba kayan ado. Angon ya aiko mata da munduwa ta zinariya guda biyu da zobe. Rahamatu ta sa munduwa ɗaya a hannun dama, ɗayar a hannun hagu. Duk lokacin da ta motsa hannu, munduwar biyu suna sheƙi kamar rana.

Abu na ƙarshe shi ne turare. Abida ta fito da wata ƙaramar kwalba daga jakarta. "Wannan man wardi ne na asali. Ƙamshinsa kamar na furen wardi ne da aka tsinko da asuba." Ta ɗan shafa wa Rahamatu a wuya da hannaye, kuma ɗakin duka ya cika da ƙamshin wardi.

A ranar Asabar, bayan an ɗaura aure a masallaci, aka kai amarya gidan mijinta. Mata suka yi ta tafa hannu suna waƙa. Duk lokacin da Rahamatu ta fito da sabon kaya, sai su ƙara tafa hannu da ƙarfi, har tsofaffin mata ma suka tafa suna murmushi.

Bayan biki, ita da mijinta suka tafi amarci a Jos na mako guda. Daga can ta aika wa Abida saƙo: "Na gode da kitso da duk taimakonki. Amarcinmu yana da daɗi, kuma sanyin Jos ya yi mana daɗi."

Tambayoyi:
Wane albishir ne Abida ta kawo?
Ta ce tela ya gama ɗinka kayan Rahamatu duka, kuma sun yi kyau.
Awa nawa kitson ya ɗauka?
Kitson ya ɗauki awa huɗu.
Me ya sa Abida ta sake ɗaure zanin?
Domin zanin ya ɗan yi wa Rahamatu yawa a ƙugu.
Me angon ya aiko mata?
Ya aiko mata da munduwa ta zinariya guda biyu da zobe.
Ina suka tafi amarci?
Sun tafi amarci a Jos na mako guda.

lessons.title: Wando mai kunkuntar ƙafa
lessons.summary: Imran wants fashionable trousers with narrow legs; the old tailor Maiwada advises against it but measures him, writing the numbers on a scrap of cloth; the trousers grip his thighs, the tailor loosens and tightens them, and Imran finds his pockets empty when it is time to pay the balance.
lessons.text:
Imran matashi ne ɗan shekara ashirin da biyu, kuma yana son bin abin da yake tashe. A wannan shekara, samarin unguwarsu suna sa wando mai kunkuntar ƙafa, wanda yake matse jiki daga cinya har zuwa idon sawu. Imran ma yana so ya ɗinka irinsa kafin Sallah.

Ya ɗauki yadin da ya saya, ya tafi shagon Malam Maiwada, tela mafi shahara a unguwar. Malam Maiwada dattijo ne mai hankali, wanda ya shafe shekara talatin yana ɗinki. Imran ya gaishe shi, ya ce, "Malam, ina so ka ɗinka mini wando mai kunkuntar ƙafa, kamar na samarin da ke cikin waɗannan hotunan." Ya nuna masa hotuna a wayarsa.

Malam Maiwada ya kalli hotunan, ya girgiza kai. "Ɗana, gwamma ka bar ƙafar wandon ta ɗan yi faɗi. Wando mai kunkuntar ƙafa yana matse cinya, ba zai bar ka ka zauna ko ka durƙusa da kyau ba. Gwamma a yi maka abin da zai ba ka sauƙi da a yi maka abin da zai takura ka."

Amma Imran ya dage. Sai tela ya auna shi: ƙugu, cinya da tsawon ƙafa. Malam Maiwada ba ya amfani da takarda. Duk awon da ya yi, yana rubuta shi a kan wani ɗan ƙyalle, sannan ya ɗaure ƙyallen a jikin yadin, don kada ya manta da mai yadin.

Kuɗin ɗinkin naira dubu goma ne. Imran ya biya rabi, ya ce zai kawo ciko idan ya zo karɓar wandon. Tela ya ce, "Babu laifi. Ka kawo cikon ranar Alhamis."

A ranar Alhamis, Imran ya zo, ya sa wandon a ɗakin bayan shagon. Wandon ya matse shi sosai, musamman a cinya. Ya yi ƙoƙarin zama, amma ya kasa. Tela ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Ba na faɗa maka ba?" Sai ya ɗauki allura ya ɗan buɗe ɗinkin cinyar wandon, sannan ya tsuke ƙugun wandon kaɗan, don kada ya zame. "Yanzu za ka iya zama," in ji shi.

Sai matsala ta biyu ta taso. Imran ya sa hannu a aljihunsa don ya fito da cikon kuɗin, amma aljihun fanko ne. Ya duba ɗayan aljihun: shi ma fanko ne. Ba shi da ko sisi! Ruɗu ya kama shi: ina kuɗin suka tafi? Sai ya tuna cewa ya canza wando da safe, ya bar kuɗin a cikin tsohon wandonsa a gida.

Cikin ruɗu, ya fara ba tela haƙuri. Malam Maiwada ya kwantar masa da hankali. "Ba laifi, ɗana. Ka je ka kawo cikon. Amma ba zan ba ka wandon ba sai na ga kuɗin, kuma ko sisi ba za a rage ba."

Imran ya ruga gida, ya dawo da cikon cikin minti ashirin. Ya biya, ya karɓi wandonsa. Ya ga cewa dole ne ya tsuke bakin aljihunsa har ƙarshen wata, domin aljihunsa zai zauna fanko na ɗan lokaci. Kafin ya tafi, ya ce, "Malam, lallai gwamma in saurari shawarar dattijo da in bi abin da yake tashe kawai."

Tambayoyi:
Wane irin wando ne Imran yake so?
Yana son wando mai kunkuntar ƙafa, wanda yake matse jiki daga cinya.
A kan me tela yake rubuta awon da ya yi?
Yana rubuta shi a kan wani ɗan ƙyalle.
Nawa ne Imran ya biya da farko?
Ya biya rabin kuɗin, wato naira dubu biyar.
Me ya sa ruɗu ya kama Imran?
Domin aljihunsa fanko ne, ba shi da ko sisi.
Ina kuɗin suke?
Suna cikin tsohon wandonsa a gida.

lessons.title: Farar riga a lokacin damina
lessons.summary: On a rainy Friday in Kaduna, a car splashes filthy drain water over Khadijat's new white dress on her way to a naming ceremony; she soaks it in a basin, dries it before a fan overnight, shakes the dust off the next morning, has it ironed, and wears it to her friend's house the day after.
lessons.text:
Khadijat tana aiki a wani banki a Kaduna. Wata ranar Juma'a, an gayyace ta bikin suna na 'yar ƙawarta da yamma. Ta sa sabuwar farar riga mai tsada wadda ta saya musamman don bikin. Kafin ta fita, ta ga sama ya yi duhu, sai ta ɗauki laima.

Tana tafiya a gefen titi da laimarta a hannu, sai ruwan sama ya fara sauka. Laimar ta kare mata kai da kafaɗu, amma ba ta kare mata ƙafafu ba. Ba zato, sai wata mota ta wuce da gudu ta cikin ruwan da ya taru kusa da magudanar ruwa. Ruwan ya watsu a jikin Khadijat. Ba ruwa mai tsabta ba ne: najasa ce daga magudanar, mai baƙin launi da wari mai banƙyama.

Khadijat ta tsaya tana kallon rigarta. Daga gwiwa har ƙasa, farar rigar ta yi baƙi da najasa. Warin ya yi banƙyama har ta kasa numfashi da kyau. Wasu mutane da ke tsaye a ƙarƙashin wata rumfa suka ce, "Kai! Allah ya kiyaye." Ta san cewa ba za ta iya zuwa biki da irin wannan kaya ba, sai ta juya ta koma gida.

Da ta isa gida, ta cire rigar nan da nan. Ta cika baho da ruwan ɗumi da sabulu, ta saka rigar a ciki. Ta bar ta a cikin bahon na awa ɗaya, sannan ta wanke ta da hannu sau uku, har sai da babu alamar najasa a jikinta, kuma warin mai banƙyama ya tafi.

Matsala ta gaba ita ce yadda za ta busar da rigar. Har yanzu ana ruwan sama, ba za ta iya shanya ta a waje ba. Sai ta rataya ta a cikin ɗaki a gaban fanka, ta bar fankar tana kaɗawa dukan dare don ta busar da ita.

Kashegari da safe, ta tashi ta je ta duba rigar. Rigar ta bushe sarai; busasshiya ce, babu ruwa ko kaɗan a cikinta. Amma iskar fankar ta kawo ƙura daga taga, kuma akwai ƙura kaɗan a jikin busasshiyar rigar. Khadijat ta fita da rigar baranda, ta karkaɗe ta sau da yawa har ƙurar ta tafi. Ta karkaɗe ta a hankali, don kada ta yage.

Sannan ta kai rigar wurin mai guga a bakin layi. Mai gugar ya yi mata guga mai kyau, ya naɗe rigar da kyau a cikin leda. Kashegari kuma, ranar Lahadi, ta sa rigar ta je gidan ƙawarta, ta ba ta kyautar jaririyar. Ƙawarta ta ce, "Ba wanda zai gane cewa wannan riga ta taɓa shiga najasa!"

Tun daga wannan rana, Khadijat ba ta fita da farar riga a lokacin damina, ko da tana da laima.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Khadijat ta ɗauki laima?
Domin ta ga sama ya yi duhu kafin ta fita.
Me ya faru da rigarta a hanya?
Wata mota ta watsa mata najasa daga magudanar ruwa.
Ina ta saka rigar don ta wanke ta?
Ta saka ta a cikin baho da ruwan ɗumi da sabulu.
Ta yaya ta busar da rigar?
Ta rataya ta a gaban fanka dukan dare.
Me ta yi kashegari da safe?
Ta karkaɗe ƙurar da ke jikin rigar, sannan ta kai ta wurin mai guga.

lessons.title: Kutse a kasuwar tufafi
lessons.summary: A news report from Kano: thieves break into a cloth market at night, smash eleven shop doors and loot wax prints and other clothes; police raid the market, clash with them, rout them and catch one who fell flat from a wall; the next morning a crowd of traders gathers and a ruined trader calls it an outrage.
lessons.text:
Kano: 'Yan sanda sun kama mutum huɗu bayan kutse a kasuwar tufafi

Rundunar 'yan sanda ta jihar Kano ta ce ta kama wasu matasa huɗu da ake zargi da yin kutse a cikin babbar kasuwar tufafi ta birnin a daren Talata. Kakakin rundunar, Tahiru, ya shaida wa manema labarai cewa ɓarayin sun shiga kasuwar ne da misalin ƙarfe biyu na dare, bayan sun yanke wayar shingen da ke bayan kasuwar.

A cewarsa, ɓarayin sun farfasa ƙofofin shaguna goma sha ɗaya da gatari da guduma, sannan suka wawure atamfa, shadda da sauran kayan sawa da kuɗinsu ya kai miliyoyin naira. Sun kuma farfasa gilashin wasu shagunan da ke sayar da takalma da jakunkuna. "Sun wawure duk abin da za su iya ɗauka, suka loda shi a cikin wata tsohuwar mota," in ji shi.

Wani mai gadi da ya ga abin da ke faruwa ya kira 'yan sanda ta waya. Cikin minti ashirin, jami'an tsaro suka kai samame a kasuwar. An yi artabu tsakanin 'yan sandan da ɓarayin na kusan rabin awa, domin ɗaya daga cikinsu yana da bindiga. Bayan artabun, 'yan sandan sun yi nasarar fatattakar ɓarayin, kuma ɓarayin suka gudu suka bar motar da kayan a wurin.

Ɗaya daga cikin ɓarayin ya yi ƙoƙarin guduwa ta saman katanga, amma ya zame, ya faɗi warwas a ƙasa, inda 'yan sanda suka kama shi. "Ya faɗi warwas kamar buhun gari, bai iya tashi ba sai da muka ɗaga shi," in ji kakakin. Bayanan da ya ba su ne suka kai su ga sauran mutum ukun.

Kashegari, 'yan sanda sun kuma kai samame a wani gida a bayan gari, inda suka gano atamfa ɗari biyu da sauran kayan da aka wawure. Kakakin ya ce bayan fatattakar ɓarayin a kasuwa, sun ɓoye sauran kayan a wannan gida, suna shirin kai su wata ƙasa don su sayar.

Da safiyar Laraba, dandazon 'yan kasuwa da masu saye sun taru a ƙofar kasuwar suna kallon ɓarnar, kuma dandazon ya ƙaru da rana. A cikin dandazon akwai wani ɗan kasuwa, Malam Zainu, wanda aka wawure shagonsa gaba ɗaya. Ya ce, "Wannan ta'asa ce. Mun shafe shekaru muna tara jari, sai a cikin dare ɗaya a farfasa mana shaguna a kwashe komai."

Shugaban 'yan kasuwar ya ce wannan ta'asa ba ita ce ta farko ba, kuma ya roƙi gwamnati ta sa fitilu da ƙarin masu gadi a kasuwar. Ya kuma gode wa 'yan sanda bisa samamen da suka kai da wuri.

Rundunar 'yan sanda ta ce za a kai mutanen huɗu kotu bayan an kammala bincike, kuma ta roƙi masu shagunan da aka yi wa kutse su zo ofishinta su gane kayansu.

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe ɓarayin suka shiga kasuwar?
Sun shiga ne da misalin ƙarfe biyu na daren Talata.
Me ɓarayin suka farfasa?
Sun farfasa ƙofofin shaguna goma sha ɗaya da gilashin wasu shaguna.
Yaya aka kama ɓarawo na farko?
Ya faɗi warwas daga saman katanga, sai 'yan sanda suka kama shi.
Ina aka gano sauran kayan?
An gano su a wani gida a bayan gari, bayan 'yan sanda sun kai samame.
Me Malam Zainu ya ce?
Ya ce wannan ta'asa ce, domin an wawure shagonsa gaba ɗaya.

lessons.title: Abaya daga Kuwaiti
lessons.summary: Umaimatu sells abayas on a social-media platform; she gets a visa and flies to Kuwait to see where her goods come from, bargains in dinars with gestures, and her accountant Djibo finds a surplus; when a rival posts a fabricated photo questioning the authenticity of her goods, she answers with proof from her trip.
lessons.text:
Umaimatu tana sayar da abaya da mayafai ta intanet. Ba ta da shago a kasuwa; duk kasuwancinta yana kan wani dandamali na sada zumunta, inda take ɗora hotunan kaya, masu saye su zaɓa, su biya ta waya. A cikin shekara biyu, mabiyanta a dandamalin sun kai dubu hamsin.

Mafi yawan kayanta suna fitowa ne daga Kuwaiti. Wata ƙawarta da ke zaune a can ce madogararta: ita ce take saya mata kaya a kasuwannin Kuwaiti tana turo mata. Amma a bana, Umaimatu ta yanke shawarar ta je da kanta, don ta tabbatar da sahihancin kayan da take sayarwa, kuma ta samo sabuwar madogara mai rahusa.

Da farko sai ta nemi biza. Ta cika fom ɗin neman biza ta intanet, ta haɗa da fasfo, hoto da takardar banki. Bizar ta ɗauki makonni uku kafin ta fito. Da ta samu bizar, ta yi tsalle don murna.

A Kuwaiti, ta canza kuɗinta zuwa dinari. Dinarin Kuwaiti yana da daraja sosai: dinari ɗaya ya fi dalar Amurka uku. Wani mai shago ya ce mata abaya ɗaya dinari takwas ce. Sai ta yi masa ishara da hannu cewa ta yi tsada, ya rage zuwa dinari shida. Ba ta jin Larabci sosai, don haka yawancin cinikinta da ishara take yi, da lambobi a wayarta.

Ta sayi abaya ɗari, ta dawo gida. Akawunta, Malam Djibo, ya yi lissafi, ya ce, "Bayan an cire kuɗin jirgi, na biza da na kaya, akwai rara ta naira miliyan ɗaya. Wannan rarar ta fi ta bara." Umaimatu ta yi farin ciki, ta ce za ta ajiye rarar don ta buɗe shago a nan gaba.

Sai wata matsala ta taso a dandamalin. Wata mai irin kasuwancinta ta rubuta cewa kayan Umaimatu ba na Kuwaiti ba ne, na jabu ne. Ta kuma ɗora wani ƙirƙirarren hoto, inda aka nuna wata mace tana kuka cewa abayar da ta saya ta yage bayan kwana biyu. Mutane da yawa sun yarda da ƙirƙirarren labarin, suka fara tambayar sahihancin kayan Umaimatu.

Umaimatu ba ta yi faɗa ba. Ta ɗora bidiyon tafiyarta: hotonta a gaban shagon da ke Kuwaiti, takardun da aka rubuta kuɗin da dinari, da bizarta a cikin fasfo. Akawunta ma ya rubuta cewa duk cinikinta yana cikin littafinsa. Bayan kwana biyu, wani ya gano cewa ƙirƙirarren hoton daga wani shafin waje aka ɗauko shi.

Mabiyanta suka gane gaskiya, wasu ma suka ba ta haƙuri. Umaimatu ta rubuta, "Duk wanda yake shakka game da sahihancin kayana, ya zo ya gani da idonsa."

Tambayoyi:
A ina Umaimatu take sayar da kayanta?
Tana sayar da su a kan wani dandamali na sada zumunta.
Me ya sa ta tafi Kuwaiti da kanta?
Don ta tabbatar da sahihancin kayanta, kuma ta samo sabuwar madogara.
Ta yaya ta yi ciniki da mai shago?
Ta yi masa ishara da hannu, kuma ta yi amfani da lambobi a wayarta.
Nawa ne rarar da akawunta ya gano?
Ya gano rara ta naira miliyan ɗaya.
Me ɗayar mai kasuwancin ta ɗora a dandamalin?
Ta ɗora wani ƙirƙirarren hoto da labarin cewa abayar Umaimatu ta yage.

lessons.title: Tufafin ibada
lessons.summary: A column on the clothes people wear to worship: Friday mosques packed full, clean clothes and the ablution ewers, an imam on what leading prayers asks of him, humility before the reckoning and asking forgiveness; at a church, a pastor on his robe before the altar and the Pope's white, and both men on the bond between neighbours.
lessons.text:
A wannan mako, mai karatu, ina so mu dubi tufafin da mutane suke sa wa zuwa wuraren ibada a ƙasarmu, musulmi da kirista.

A ranar Juma'a, masallatan Kano sukan cika maƙil tun kafin a fara huɗuba. Kowa yana sa mafi kyawun tufafinsa: babbar riga, doguwar riga ko jallabiya, da hula. Amma tufafin ibada ba ado kawai ba ne; dole ne su kasance masu tsabta. Idan najasa ta taɓa riga, sai an wanke ta kafin a yi salla da ita. Shi ya sa a ƙofar kowane masallaci za ka ga buta da yawa a jere, domin masu alwala. Mutum zai ɗauki buta, ya yi alwala, sannan ya shiga da tsabtar jiki da ta tufafi.

Na yi hira da Malam Abdulsamad, wanda ya shafe shekara ashirin yana limanci a wani masallaci a Kano. Ya ce mini, "Limanci nauyi ne. Liman yana gaban jama'a, don haka dole ya sa tufafi masu tsabta da mutunci, amma ba na alfahari ba." Ya ƙara da cewa, "Ba ma yin ibada don a ga sabon kayanmu. Ranar hisabi, ba za a tambaye ka kuɗin rigarka ba, sai abin da ka aikata."

Malam Abdulsamad yana koya wa matasa cewa ƙasƙanci a gaban Allah ya fi kowane ado. A cewarsa, mutum ya sa tufafinsa cikin ƙasƙanci, ba don ya nuna wa maƙwabcinsa cewa ya fi shi arziki ba. Ya kuma ce duk wanda ya ɓata wa wani rai, to ya nemi yafiyarsa tun kafin ranar hisabi. "Neman yafiya ba zai rage maka daraja ba; yana ƙara maka daraja ne," in ji shi.

A coci ma, al'amarin ya yi kama da haka. Na ziyarci wani coci a Kaduna a ranar Lahadi, inda cocin ya cika maƙil da mutane cikin kaya masu kyau. Fasto Markus ya tsaya a gaban bagade cikin doguwar farar riga. Ya ce mini rigar da yake sa wa a gaban bagade alama ce ta tsarki, kuma launin kayan da ke kan bagade yana canzawa a lokuta daban daban na shekara.

Ya kuma tuna mini cewa Fafaroma, shugaban ɗariƙar Katolika a duniya, yana sa farar riga a kullum. "Ko Fafaroma, wanda miliyoyin mutane suke girmamawa, yana tsayawa a gaban Allah cikin ƙasƙanci," in ji shi.

Abin da ya haɗa malaman biyu shi ne, dukansu suna ganin cewa tufafin ibada alama ce ta girmamawa, ba ta alfahari ba. Kuma dukansu suna wa'azi kan danƙon zumunci tsakanin musulmi da kirista da ke zaune a unguwa ɗaya. Fasto Markus ya ce, "Danƙon zumuncinmu ya fi ƙarfin bambancin tufafinmu." Malam Abdulsamad kuma ya ce, "Maƙwabcinka ɗan uwanka ne, ko wace irin riga yake sa wa."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa ake ajiye buta a ƙofar masallaci?
Domin masu alwala su ɗauka su yi alwala kafin su shiga.
Shekara nawa Malam Abdulsamad ya yi yana limanci?
Ya shafe shekara ashirin yana limanci.
Me Malam Abdulsamad ya ce game da ranar hisabi?
Ya ce ranar hisabi ba za a tambaye ka kuɗin rigarka ba, sai abin da ka aikata.
Me Malam Abdulsamad ya ce game da neman yafiya?
Ya ce duk wanda ya ɓata wa wani rai ya nemi yafiyarsa tun kafin ranar hisabi.
A ina Fasto Markus yake tsayawa?
Yana tsayawa a gaban bagade cikin doguwar farar riga.
Me malaman biyu suke wa'azi a kai?
Suna wa'azi kan danƙon zumunci tsakanin musulmi da kirista.

lessons.title: Haramcin matsattsun kaya
lessons.summary: An opinion column: a local council bans very tight clothes in its markets and motor parks; a quarrel flares up online between those who say they are fighting indecency and immorality and those who call it meddling in private life; some incite young people to protest, and the columnist argues that each side has a limit and the whole community must be heard.
lessons.text:
A makon da ya wuce, majalisar wata ƙaramar hukuma a arewacin ƙasar nan ta sanar da haramcin sa kaya masu matse jiki a kasuwanni da tashoshin mota. A cewar sanarwar, haramcin ya shafi maza da mata, kuma duk wanda aka kama za a ci shi tara. Tun daga ranar, muhawara ta kaure a shafukan sada zumunta, kuma har yanzu ba ta lafa ba.

Masu goyon bayan haramcin sun ce suna yaƙi da alfasha ne. A ganinsu, kaya masu nuna jiki a gaban jama'a alfasha ce da ba ta dace da al'adunmu ba. Wani malami ya ce irin waɗannan kaya suna buɗe ƙofar fasikanci a tsakanin matasa, kuma ya fara la'antar 'yan kasuwar da suke shigo da su. Ya ce, "Idan muka bar alfasha ta yaɗu a kasuwanninmu, fasikanci zai biyo baya."

Masu adawa da haramcin kuma suna ganin wannan katsalandan ne a rayuwar mutane. Wata matashiya ta rubuta, "Me ya sa majalisa za ta yi katsalandan a kan abin da zan sa? Ina da mutunci, kuma ba alfasha nake yi ba." Wasu kuma sun ce gwamnati tana da ayyuka mafi muhimmanci, kamar hanyoyi, asibitoci da ruwan sha, maimakon ta tsaya tana auna wandunan mutane.

Abin da ya fi ba ni tsoro shi ne yadda wasu suka fara zuga matasa. Wasu 'yan siyasa sun fara zuga matasa su fito su yi bore a gaban majalisar, wasu kuma suna zuga masu goyon bayan haramcin su kama duk wanda suka gani da matsattsun kaya. Kowane ɓangare ya fara la'antar ɗayan, kamar ba mutanen gari ɗaya ba ne.

A ganina, akwai haddi a nan, kuma kowane ɓangare ya kamata ya san haddinsa. Hukuma tana da ikon kare tarbiyya a wuraren jama'a, amma ba ta da ikon shiga gidan kowa ta duba abin da yake sa wa. Haka kuma ɗan ƙasa yana da 'yancin zaɓar kayansa, amma 'yancinsa yana da haddi idan ya taɓa al'adun al'ummar da yake zaune a cikinta.

Ina kira ga majalisar ta zauna da ilahirin al'ummar garin: malamai, 'yan kasuwa, iyaye, mata da matasa. Doka da aka yi ba tare da jin ra'ayin ilahirin jama'a ba, ko da manufarta mai kyau ce, takan haifar da rikici. Ina kuma kira ga matasa: kada ku bari kowa ya zuga ku zuwa tashin hankali. Muhawara tana da kyau, amma idan faɗa ya kaure a kasuwa, ba zai kawo mafita ba.

Tambayoyi:
Me majalisar ta sanar?
Ta sanar da haramcin sa kaya masu matse jiki a kasuwanni da tashoshin mota.
Me masu goyon bayan haramcin suka ce?
Sun ce suna yaƙi da alfasha da fasikanci.
Me ya sa wasu suke ganin haramcin katsalandan ne?
Domin suna ganin bai kamata majalisa ta shiga abin da mutum zai sa ba.
Me ya fi ba marubucin tsoro?
Yadda wasu suka fara zuga matasa su yi bore ko faɗa.
Me marubucin ya roƙi majalisar ta yi?
Ya roƙe ta ta zauna da ilahirin al'ummar garin.

lessons.title: Fikinik na kaboyi
lessons.summary: Zayyad and his younger brother and sister hold a costume picnic in a Jos park; Zayyad comes dressed as a cowboy, Salmanu fries plantain, Shamsiya mixes a drink, they buy suya and biscuits and chew gum; a big tomcat steals a stick of suya while the cowboy chases it in vain.
lessons.text:
Zayyad da ƙannensa biyu, Salmanu da Shamsiya, sun shirya fikinik a wani lambu a Jos a ranar Asabar. Shamsiya ce ta kawo shawarar cewa a wannan karon kowa zai zo da kayan wani tauraron fim. "Fikinik na bana dole ne ya bambanta da na bara," in ji ta.

Zayyad ya zo cikin kayan kaboyi: babbar hula mai faɗi, riga mai launin ruwan ƙasa, wando mai kauri, da takalma masu tsawo. Ya ɗaura bel mai faɗi a ƙugunsa, har da wata bindigar wasa a gefe. Da ya fito daga mota, yara da ke wasa a lambun suka yi ta ihu, "Kaboyi! Kaboyi!" Zayyad ya ɗaga hularsa ya gaishe su kamar kaboyin fim.

Salmanu kuma ya zo da ƙaramin risho da kasko, domin shi ne mai girki. Ya kafa risho a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya, ya fara tuya. Ya soya ayaba da dankali, kuma ƙamshin tuyar ya cika wurin. "Tuya a sararin Allah ta fi ta cikin gida daɗi," in ji Salmanu.

Shamsiya ta zo da kwalaben ruwa da lemo. Ta gauraya ruwan lemo da citta da sukari a cikin wata babbar kwalba. Bayan ta gauraya su sosai, ta zuba wa kowa a kofi. Zayyad ya sha ya ce, "Wannan lemo kamar na otal yake!"

Da rana ta yi, Zayyad ya tafi bakin hanya ya sayo suya daga wani mai suya. Mai suyar ya ga kayan kaboyin, ya yi dariya, ya ƙara masa tsinke biyu na suya kyauta. Shamsiya kuma ta buɗe kwalayen biskit guda biyu da ta saya a kasuwa, ta jera biskit ɗin a kan faranti. Bayan sun ci, Shamsiya ta ba kowa ɗan cingam ya tauna, ita kuma ta ce, "Ku tauna a hankali, kada ku haɗiye shi."

Suna cikin hira, sai wani babban muzuru mai launin toka ya fito daga bayan bishiya. Muzurun ya dube su, sannan ya yi tsalle ya kama tsinken suya ɗaya daga kan faranti, ya ruga. Zayyad ya tashi cikin kayan kaboyinsa ya bi shi, amma takalmansa masu tsawo sun yi masa nauyi. Muzurun ya hau bishiya, ya zauna a can yana tauna suyar. Salmanu da Shamsiya suka yi dariya har suka kasa tsayawa. "Kaboyin da muzuru ya ci nasara a kansa!" in ji Salmanu.

Kafin su tafi gida, suka sayi kirim daga wani mai babur da ke sayar da shi a lambun. Kowa ya ci kirim ɗinsa da biskit, kuma kirim ɗin ya yi sanyi sosai. Shamsiya ta ce, "Fikinik na gaba, ni ce zan zo da kayan kaboyi, kuma ba zan bar wani muzuru ya ci suyata ba."

Tambayoyi:
Ina suka yi fikinik?
Sun yi fikinik a wani lambu a Jos.
Wane irin kaya Zayyad ya sa?
Ya sa kayan kaboyi, da babbar hula da takalma masu tsawo.
Me Salmanu ya yi da risho?
Ya yi tuya: ya soya ayaba da dankali.
Me Shamsiya ta gauraya?
Ta gauraya ruwan lemo da citta da sukari.
Me muzurun ya yi?
Ya kama tsinken suya ɗaya, ya hau bishiya yana tauna shi.

lessons.title: Mai zanen kaya da sikila
lessons.summary: Zahra'u, a young Kaduna fashion designer born with sickle cell, pants on the stairs and suffers a crisis before a fashion show; Dr Amadi tells her the disease has weakened her hip and she needs an operation, and warns that it can also bring blindness; she is shocked, but has the surgery and shows her new collection months later.
lessons.text:
Zahra'u mai zanen kaya ce a Kaduna. Tana zana riguna da abaya, tana ɗinka su a ƙaramin shagonta, kuma ana sa kayanta a bukukuwa da yawa. Amma tun haihuwarta tana da cutar sikila. Cutar sikila tana sa jinin mutum ya kasa ɗaukar iska da kyau, kuma takan kawo ciwo mai tsanani a ƙashi.

A watan da ya wuce, Zahra'u tana shirin wani babban bikin nuna kaya. Tana aiki dare da rana. Duk lokacin da ta hau matakalar shagonta, sai ta tsaya tana huci. Huci ya zama abokinta: ko ɗan nisa ta yi tafiya, sai numfashinta ya yi sauri. Wata rana tana ɗinki, sai ciwo mai tsanani ya kama ta a ƙugu, ta kasa tashi.

Aka kai ta asibiti. Likitanta, Dokta Amadi, ya duba ta, ya yi mata hoton ƙashi. Dokta Amadi ya daɗe yana kula da masu sikila, kuma ya san Zahra'u tun tana yarinya. Ya zauna da ita, ya ce, "Zahra'u, sikila ta gurgunta ƙashin ƙugunki. Jini ba ya isa wurin da kyau, don haka ƙashin yana mutuwa a hankali. Idan muka bar shi haka, zai ci gaba da gurgunta ki har ki kasa tafiya."

"To, me za a yi, Dokta?" ta tambaya.

"Za a yi miki fiɗa. Fiɗar za ta canza wannan ɓangare na ƙashin da wani sabo."

Zahra'u ta gigice. Ba ta taɓa tunanin fiɗa ba. Ta gigice har ta kasa magana na ɗan lokaci. Sannan Dokta Amadi ya ƙara da cewa ya kamata ta riƙa zuwa likitan ido, domin sikila takan lalata jijiyoyin ido, kuma idan ba a kula ba, tana iya kawo makanta. "Ba na so in tsoratar da ke ba," in ji shi. "Makanta ba ta zuwa farat ɗaya. Idan ana duba idonki a kai a kai, za a iya hana ta."

Zahra'u ta koma gida cikin damuwa. Ta ji kamar ta faɗa cikin ƙangi: ga biki ya kusa, ga fiɗa, ga tsoron makanta. Mahaifiyarta ta kwantar mata da hankali, ta ce, "Kowane ƙangi yana da mafita. Kayanki za su jira ki; lafiyarki ba za ta jira ba."

Bayan mako biyu, aka yi mata fiɗar, kuma ta yi nasara. Ta yi watanni uku tana tafiya da sanda, tana ɗinki a zaune. Ta kuma fara zuwa likitan ido kowane wata shida. A ƙarshen shekara, ta nuna sababbin kayanta a wani biki a Kaduna. Da ta fito a gaban jama'a ba tare da sanda ba, Dokta Amadi yana zaune a layin farko yana murmushi.

Tambayoyi:
Wace cuta ce Zahra'u take da ita?
Tana da cutar sikila tun haihuwarta.
Me ke faruwa da ita idan ta hau matakala?
Takan tsaya tana huci.
Yaya Zahra'u ta ji da Dokta Amadi ya ce za a yi mata fiɗa?
Ta gigice, har ta kasa magana na ɗan lokaci.
Me Dokta Amadi ya ce sikila ta yi wa ƙashinta?
Ya ce sikila ta gurgunta ƙashin ƙugunta.
Me ya sa ya ce ta riƙa zuwa likitan ido?
Domin sikila tana iya kawo makanta idan ba a kula ba.
Me mahaifiyarta ta ce mata?
Ta ce kowane ƙangi yana da mafita.

lessons.title: Kufai na tsohuwar fada
lessons.summary: Malam Maikudi takes his class to the ruins of an old town beside a stream, where a small museum shows the clothes of a past king, his attendants and his maidservants, sandals of bull's hide and a carved palace ceiling; Zubair tears his trousers on a thorn bush and the class hears an owl that lives in the ruins.
lessons.text:
Malam Maikudi malamin tarihi ne a wata makarantar sakandare. A ranar Alhamis, ya ɗauki ɗalibansa ashirin zuwa wani kufai na tsohon gari da ke da nisan kilomita talatin daga birni. Shekaru ɗari biyu da suka wuce, wannan gari yana da sarki, fada da kasuwa, amma yanzu kufai ne kawai: tsofaffin katangu da suka rushe, da ciyawa a ko'ina.

Wannan kufai yana gefen wani gulbi mai ruwa mai tsabta. Malam Maikudi ya ce, "Mutanen da suka gina wannan gari sun zaɓi wurin ne saboda gulbin. Ruwan gulbi ya ba su abin sha, kuma ya ba su ruwan da suke rina tufafinsu da shi."

A tsakiyar kufai akwai ƙaramin gidan tarihi. A ciki an ajiye tufafin sarakunan da, da na hadimansu, har ma da na kuyangar matar sarki. Mai kula da gidan ya nuna musu wata babbar riga ta sarki, sannan ya nuna jajayen rawunan da hadiman sarki suke naɗawa. "Kowane hadimi yana da aikinsa," in ji shi. "Wani hadimi yana riƙe da takalman sarki, wani kuma yana riƙe da laimarsa a lokacin rana."

Ya kuma nuna musu wani zani mai launin shuɗi. "Wannan na wata kuyanga ce ta matar sarki. Kuyanga ba ta da 'yanci a wancan zamani, amma kuyangar fada tana sa kaya masu kyau, domin tana wakiltar fadar."

Ɗaya daga cikin ɗaliban, Zubair, ya tambaya, "Yaya sarki yake sa wa a lokacin samartakarsa?" Mai kula ya nuna musu wata ƙaramar riga mai ado. "Wannan ita ce rigar da sarki na ƙarshe ya sa a lokacin samartakarsa, kafin a naɗa shi. A samartaka, 'ya'yan sarki suna sa kaya masu sauƙi, sai bayan naɗi suke sa manyan kaya."

Akwai kuma takalma na fatar bijimi. A cewar mai kula, a ranar naɗin sarki ana yanka bijimi, a yi takalman sabon sarki da fatarsa. "Fatar bijimi tana da ƙarfi sosai; shi ya sa waɗannan takalma ba su lalace ba har yau."

Sannan ya kai su cikin wani ɗaki na tsohuwar fadar da har yanzu yake da rufi. Silin ɗin an yi shi da itacen giginya, kuma an yi masa zane mai kyau. Ɗaliban suka ɗaga kai suna kallon silin. A wani lungu na silin, suka ga wata mujiya tana barci. "Mujiya tana zaune a nan tun shekaru da yawa," in ji mai kula. "Da dare ne take fita farauta."

Da suka fita, Zubair ya ratsa ta cikin wani daji na ƙaya don ya ɗauki hoton gulbin. Ƙaya ta kama wandonsa ta yage shi a gwiwa. Malam Maikudi ya ce, "Shi ya sa na ce ku bi hanya! Ƙaya ba ta san wandon makaranta ba." Kowa ya yi dariya, har da Zubair.

Tambayoyi:
Ina wannan kufai yake?
Wannan kufai yana gefen wani gulbi, kilomita talatin daga birni.
Me ya sa mutanen da suka gina garin suka zaɓi wurin?
Saboda gulbin, wanda ya ba su ruwan sha da ruwan rina tufafi.
Me hadiman sarki suke naɗawa?
Suna naɗa jajayen rawuna.
Da me aka yi takalman sabon sarki?
An yi su da fatar bijimi da aka yanka a ranar naɗi.
Me ɗaliban suka gani a silin?
Sun ga wata mujiya tana barci a wani lungu na silin.
